mapper.select:
SELECT id, household_size_code, household_size_label, survey_year, avg_income, median_income, avg_asset, median_asset, avg_debt, median_debt, avg_net_worth, median_net_worth, avg_debt_repayment, median_debt_repayment, avg_household_head_age, household_distribution_pct
FROM kosis_household_net_worth
WHERE household_size_label = #{householdSizeLabel}
ORDER BY survey_year DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT k.id, k.household_size_code, k.household_size_label, k.survey_year, k.avg_income, k.median_income, k.avg_asset, k.median_asset, k.avg_debt, k.median_debt, k.avg_net_worth, k.median_net_worth, k.avg_debt_repayment, k.median_debt_repayment, k.avg_household_head_age, k.household_distribution_pct
FROM kosis_household_net_worth k INNER JOIN ( SELECT household_size_label, MAX(survey_year) AS max_year FROM kosis_household_net_worth WHERE household_size_label != '전체' GROUP BY household_size_label ) latest ON k.household_size_label = latest.household_size_label AND k.survey_year = latest.max_year
ORDER BY k.household_size_code ASC
